1. SiteDocument.summary: Defines a SiteDocument object representing documents associated with a site.
1. SiteDocument.purpose: To model and manage documents related to a specific site in the HSPnet system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are instantiated with SiteID and ID integer properties.

2. WelcomeStaffAdmin.summary: Provides a staff admin welcome page, displaying last login, errors, warnings, and controls for viewing employment applications by site and discipline.
2. WelcomeStaffAdmin.purpose: To welcome staff admin users and provide them summary information and access to filter/view employment applications.
business_rules: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox selected.
Date fields are validated (required, regular expression, custom validator for sequence).
validations: CustomValidator: EndDate must be after StartDate.
conditions: Show error/warning panels only if content exists.
system_behavior: Last login is displayed with preferred first name and time zone.
Error and warning panels can be hidden.
Master page references and controls for site/discipline dropdowns.
Applications grid supports paging, email links, and custom formatting.

3. ServiceCode.summary: Defines the ServiceCode entity and retrieval methods for lists of service codes associated with course and timetable IDs.
3. ServiceCode.purpose: To manage and retrieve service codes for assignment and reporting purposes.

workflows.name: Retrieve ServiceCode List
steps: Process records from stored procedure, localize fields if alternate language mode.

business_rules: If alternate language is enabled in session, Name uses NameAlt.
system_behavior: ServiceCodes are retrieved via stored procedures and session context.
Localization is applied for alternate languages.

4. SiteProfileHistory.summary: Defines SiteProfileHistory entity and retrieval workflow for tracking site profile changes with user info and formatted details.
4. SiteProfileHistory.purpose: To audit and display history of site profile changes including user actions, agency, and formatted details.

workflows.name: SiteProfileHistorySearch
steps: Invoke stored procedure with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, session object.
Iterate SQL reader, build SiteProfileHistory entries, localize if required.

business_rules: Formatting of user/agency details depends on sysadmin status and user identity.
conditions: Localization uses alternate fields if session specifies.
system_behavior: Stores audit/history details for site profile changes.
Provides formatted representations for UI tooltips.

5. EmailPopupDocument.summary: Models email popup documents, supports searching and deletion of email files.
5. EmailPopupDocument.purpose: To manage temporary email popup documents/files for user workflows.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Create EmailPopupDocument objects and add to list.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Rebuild DataInfo string without deleted entry.

business_rules: Files and folders are deleted only if they exist.
Checked state is tracked per object.
system_behavior: Parses, creates, and deletes email popup document files.
